=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:232-546 (check_target 232-242; blank-target gate 268-296; unconditional hold set 322-344; consumer dispatch / already_rolled_back report 528-546) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `check_target` exempts a target whose commit equals `current_sha` from the `target_not_lower` check on every run, not only on the idempotent re-run. So an explicit `target_version` equal to the current stable version (for example v1.46.0, with no hold active) passes. The script then writes an active hold with from=to, re-dispatches every consumer, sends a CRITICAL Telegram alert and exits 0 with `outcome=already_rolled_back`, although nothing was rolled back.
  WHY: The bogus hold makes `auto_release_stable.sh` and `promote_main_cycle.sh` skip with `reason=stable_hold_active to=v1.46.0` on every tick until someone cuts a release by hand, which breaks the issue's rule that the target be "strictly lower than the current version". The blank-target path gates this case on `hold read` returning `active ${current_version}`; the explicit-target path has no such gate. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- agents.md:5607-5657 (`## Repo-tree (auto-generated)`; `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml` missing between lines 5656 and 5657) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml` but does not regenerate the auto-generated repo tree in agents.md.
  WHY: `make generate-check` fails with `FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate`, which fails static-checks and the aggregate `lint` job, and the release CI gate needs a passing `lint`. Rated BLOCKER. The other reviewers report the same issue as a task gap, below.
- tests/test_rollback_stable.py:300-320 (lines 302, 310) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `test_rerun_is_idempotent` / `test_blank_target_after_rollback_does_not_roll_back_further` / `test_partial_run_pushes_only_the_missing_tag` bind `state` and `events` but never use them.
  WHY: The flagging reviewers say Ruff F841 fails the lint gate (all three rated MAJOR). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this: it says Ruff F841 does not flag names bound by tuple unpacking, and that CI's ruff step (ci.yml:400) only checks scripts/*.py.
- tests/test_stable_hold.py:6 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The module-level `import base64` is unused; base64 is only used inside the MOCK_GH raw string (ruff F401).
  WHY: The pre-push `ruff check --select E,F --ignore E501` tier and the lint check fail. Severity disagreement: NIT from anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, MAJOR from openai_gpt-6-luna; the highest is used. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:94-110 (required-env / numeric-env validation, before `finish()` is defined) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Validation failures call `exit 1` directly and bypass `finish()`, so no `STABLE_ROLLBACK outcome=...` line is printed and no CRITICAL Telegram alert is sent.
  WHY: This breaks the header contract "every exit prints exactly one line", and the STABLE_ROLLBACK log-prefix health check and #9257 alert triage cannot account for the run. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from gemini, NIT from minimax; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash (lines ~118-130) raised it as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:354-389; .github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml:47-49 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The rollback's `stable-rollback` concurrency group is separate from the `stable-release-${{ github.repository }}` group used by the release tag jobs, and the hold does not block deliberate releases.
  WHY: A release dispatched after the drain reports no active runs can publish tags while the rollback is moving them, or afterwards, which moves the tags forward and clears the hold.
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:step 5 drain loop (`while :; do still_active=0; ... active_release_run_ids ...`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Cancel POSTs are sent only in the single pass before the drain loop. A run that becomes active after that pass is counted but never cancelled.
  WHY: The loop then exits with `release_still_running` and the tags stay unmoved. The uncancelled gate run can publish stable forward and clear the hold, so a second rollback dispatch is needed. Rated NIT.
- README.md:4763-4773 ("Roll back @stable" closing paragraph) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README says a blank target after a rollback re-confirms the current version. That holds only while the hold is active with to_version equal to the current version. After the manual clear the README itself documents (`"active": false`), a blank-target dispatch selects the next lower release.
  WHY: An operator following the README gets an unplanned second rollback: tags moved, consumers dispatched, and a new hold set. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/stable_hold.sh:247-255 (cmd_set validation block) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_set` accepts `--from` equal to `--to` and writes an active hold that describes no rollback.
  WHY: A typo, replay or caller bug writes `active=true` with from_version == to_version, and auto-release and the promote cycle skip until a deliberate release. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The auto-generated `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)` section of `agents.md` must be regenerated (`make generate`) when new files are added, so that `make generate-check` passes.
  expected_change_site: `agents.md`, `## Repo-tree (auto-generated)` section near line 5654 (insertion at `@@ -5654,6 +5654,7 @@` after `.github/workflows/review_rb_judge_dispatch.yml`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The `static-checks` CI job fails with `##[error]FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate` from `tools/repo_tree/update_repo_tree.py --check` (`make: *** [Makefile:9: generate-check] Error 1`), because the tree is missing `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml`. `agents.md` is absent from `pr_changed_files.txt`, and grep finds no hit for `rollback-stable`/`rollback_stable`/`stable_hold` in `agents.md`. The aggregate `lint` job and the release gate stay red. All four reviewers rated it BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reported the same issue as a finding.
- requirement: The PR body and commit messages must not use auto-close keywords (`Fixes`, `resolved`, etc.) against an `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue (#2734), per §19/§21 and `scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py`.
  expected_change_site: PR body line 1 and PR branch commit message #2, line 3
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` log shows `##[error][lint_pr_body_auto_close] PR body:line 1 — auto-close keyword 'Fixes' references ai:orchestrator-tracking issue #2734` and `##[error][lint_pr_body_auto_close] commit message #2:line 3 — auto-close keyword 'resolved' references ai:orchestrator-tracking issue #2734` ("though each conflict was resolved: #2734 failed"). The suggested fix is to rewrite these as `Refs #2734` and reword the commit. All three reviewers rated it BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this gap: the PR body says `Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/9342`, and in its reading the #2734 lines are fixture output from tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py printed next to `PASS` lines.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:check_target() (`if [ "${sha}" != "${current_sha}" ] && ! version_lt "${v}" "${current_version}"; then TARGET_REFUSAL=target_not_lower`); explicit-target branch; step 4 `hold set`; final `finish already_rolled_back 0` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: An explicit target_version equal to the current stable version is accepted on every run. The `sha == current_sha` exemption is not limited to the re-confirm case, and `stable_hold.sh cmd_set` does not reject from == to.
  WHY: With stable at v1.46.0, no hold and target_version=v1.46.0, the run writes an active hold from=to=v1.46.0, dispatches consumers, logs `already_rolled_back`, sends CRITICAL Telegram and exits 0. Auto-release and promote then skip until a manual release. Fix: when the target's commit equals current_sha, require `hold read` to print exactly `active ${target_input}`, else refuse target_not_lower.
- agents.md:5607 (`## Repo-tree (auto-generated)`; 5656 → 5657 has no `.github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR adds .github/workflows/rollback-stable.yml but does not regenerate the auto-generated repo tree.
  WHY: `make generate-check` fails with `FAIL: agents.md is out of date; run make generate`, failing static-checks and `lint`, and the release CI gate requires `lint`.
- tests/test_stable_hold.py:6 (`import base64`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Unused import (ruff F401) under the pre-push `ruff check --select E,F --ignore E501` gate (workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:128 RUFF_CHECK_ARGS).
  WHY: The pre-push ruff tier stays red, so "check | lint" cannot pass. Fix: delete the import.
- scripts/rollback_stable.sh:step 5 drain loop | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Runs that become active after the first cancel pass are counted but never cancelled.
  WHY: The loop exits `release_still_running`, and an uncancelled gate run can publish stable forward and clear the hold, so a second dispatch is needed. Fix: send the cancel POST for each id found inside the loop.
- README.md:"Roll back @stable" closing paragraph | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Re-confirmation happens only while the hold is active with to_version = current. After the README-documented `"active": false` clear, a blank target rolls back one more release.
  WHY: An unplanned second rollback. Fix: make the sentence conditional on an active hold.
- NOTE (2 rejected pass-1 items): the "PR body has Fixes #2734 / commit #2 resolved: #2734" item was rejected because the PR body says `Closes .../issues/9342` and the #2734 lines are fixture output from tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py (new tests wired at ci.yml:1891 into tests-promote-stall-and-review, which succeeded). The "tests/test_rollback_stable.py:302/310 unused tuple-unpacked locals" item was rejected because F841 does not flag tuple unpacking and CI ruff (ci.yml:400) only checks scripts/*.py. Release-job permissions were verified as fine (test-and-mark-stable.yml:5591 and mark-stable.yml:750 have contents: write).
- HARDENING (2 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2): in scripts/stable_hold.sh cmd_set(), add `[ "${from}" != "${to}" ] || set_failed same_version` (1 line). In scripts/rollback_stable.sh, the required-env and numeric-env validation exits 1 without a STABLE_ROLLBACK line or Telegram alert; move it below finish()/refuse() and use `refuse bad_config` (4 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
